name: 43314 · Caledonia, OH
findings: ZIP 43314 (Caledonia) has 19 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43314 (Caledonia) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 43314 (Caledonia) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.
